text: Every plate that prints the pin-hinge key holder, including a replacement, supplies fresh loose fittings. Include the standard hinge pin, centre clip and spare, slide-in OP1 retainer, two-post bar and both touch-board clips as separately identifiable objects in the slice. A complete kit includes both matching socket backing strips and any specified alternative pin fit. Include the entire set in the next complete print.
Place loose functional pins, clips and slide-in fittings separately on the plate so they can be identified and fitted without breaking them off the holder.
Include inexpensive spare loose clips and other easily lost small fittings with shipped hardware. Provide for an optional component and spares pack before release.
